activity_statements.statement: develops electronic design automation (EDA) software and IP used by semiconductor companies to design and verify integrated circuits from chips to full electromechanical systems
provides AI-driven design tools and digital twin technology for engineering silicon to systems, serving hyperscale computing, mobile, automotive, aerospace, and life sciences markets
generates $5.29 billion in annual revenue (2025) employing 13,000+ people across 70+ worldwide offices
offers molecular simulation software for life sciences customers developing drugs and biologics
provides system design and analysis tools including PCB design, signal integrity, and electromagnetic simulation for electronics engineers

name_reality_gap: The index label 'Information Technology' is technically correct but misleading. Cadence does not operate IT infrastructure or provide IT services; it makes the specialized engineering design software without which semiconductor chips and complex electronic systems cannot be designed — closer to industrial simulation software than general IT.
extraction_notes: Company about page was well-structured and provided key facts: revenue, employee count, market focus, product lines. No 10-K retrieved but about page stated 2025 revenue directly.
